title: Two Falcons, One Cat
headline: Everyone piled on one suspect each round, and Farm won two of three.
summary: Round 1 had almost no information. Farm Alex was eggsecuted over a Tit claim nobody could check, and the lone Floofer won. In rounds 2 and 3 the table converged on the Meowfia once the cover stories broke, first Blair's Tit and then Casey's copied Falcon. Casey and Ellis tied on 13 by throwing cheap cards and banking the winning ones.

title: Wink Wins Rounds
headline: A lone Mouser's Wink and a lucky split let Finley leap to second.
summary: Round 1 saw Blair, a Mouser, wink the one player who named them. Casey's Hawk got no egg because of a hug, so Farm split and threw at the wrong person. Round 2 was a clean Farm win, because Blair's Hawk claim was impossible. Round 3 had one Meowfia, Finley, hiding as a Kookaburra while Farm turned on Blair. Blair and Finley both threw at Casey, and she was eggsecuted. Ellis won on early rounds.

title: The Wink That Backfired
headline: Ellis banked 25 points as a corpse and coasted to victory.
summary: In round 1, Casey's Mouser winked Ellis, which only confirmed Ellis's accusation. Farm won, and Ellis banked 25 points while dead, which gave him a huge lead. Round 2 was a fast Farm win after Alex's Pigeon bluff failed. In round 3 the Meowfia Ellis and Blair steered the table onto Drew, a true Owl whose report came back empty, and won. Ellis's early lead made the last two rounds nearly irrelevant to who won the game.

title: Winks and Wobbly Stories
headline: Three rounds, three dead cats, and Casey quietly banked the win.
summary: Farm won all three rounds. Each time the table caught a Meowfia player through shifting stories, not hard evidence. Casey won by throwing low and always backing the winning side. Finley finished second, and the Meowfia never scored a round.

title: The Blair Runaway
headline: Blair won as Meowfia, then as Farm, and finished far ahead.
summary: In round 1, Blair (Meowfia) survived as Ellis winked the loudest accuser and the table threw at Drew, a Farm player. In round 2, Alex's Owl report exposed Blair's false Hawk claim. Meowfia still won, because Blair and Drew stacked eight votes on Alex against Farm's five at Blair. Round 3 was an easy Farm win over a lone Meowfia, and Blair banked 32 more. Blair finished on 80, nearly three times second place.

title: Wrong Eagle Rule
headline: The table fought over the Eagle card while Blair's round one jackpot decided everything.
summary: In round 1 the Meowfia pair let the table eggsecute a Farm Eagle whose count was honest. Blair staked 27 and banked 54, and nobody could catch up. Rounds 2 and 3 were more Eagle rule arguments plus Wink kills of useful Farm players. Meowfia won both rounds, but Blair still finished first on 60 despite being eggsecuted in round 3.

title: Blair's Winking Windfall
headline: One Wink and a muddled Eagle ruling handed Blair the game.
summary: Round 1 was a Farm win. Blair's Owl cover story collapsed against three visits. Round 2 was also a Farm win, but only after a muddy argument over how Eagle and Kookaburra work. In Round 3 Blair, a Meowfia Mouser, winked Casey, the Farm player doing the most analysis. The table then eggsecuted Drew, a Farm player, on the strength of a failed Eagle claim from the previous round. Blair banked 16 points and won 28 to 16.

title: Casey Banks Early
headline: Casey banked big in round 1, then coasted through two easy Farm wins.
summary: Farm won all three rounds by throwing at the Meowfia player. Casey took the lead in round 1 by banking 9 points and was never caught. Meowfia winks silenced a Farm voice twice, but the votes still landed on Meowfia each time. Round 3 ended with Ellis exposed after claiming Falcon against the real Falcon.

title: The Runaway Mouser
headline: Blair banked two Meowfia rounds off a Wink and a bluff.
summary: Round 1 was a clean Farm win: Drew's shifting Pigeon claim got him eggsecuted. Round 2 was a muddle of hug claims, and Farm eggsecuted its own Kookaburra. Round 3 saw Meowfia Blair kill the Hawk with a Wink, then Alex's unexplained +2 from a Kookaburra confusion drew the vote. Blair ended far ahead, since she was Meowfia in the two rounds that Meowfia won, and she also won round 1 as Farm.

title: The Turkey's Hidden Egg
headline: Farm lynched an innocent Falcon over eggs a Turkey quietly explained.
summary: Two rounds of tidy Farm wins ended on a single bad lynch. Round 1 caught a Floofer on a Hawk clash. Round 2 caught another Floofer on a Pigeon claim that failed Drew's count. In round 3 the lone Meowfia, Casey, sat back while the table piled onto Alex's "+2" egg count. That count was fully explained by Finley's Turkey, which nobody noticed. Casey won the round and the game by one point.

title: The Floofer Confession
headline: Casey confessed Meowfia twice, survived once, and won the whole game.
summary: Round 1 was a Farm win after Casey, the Floofer, openly claimed Meowfia. In round 2 Casey claimed it again and still lived, because Blair, a confused Kookaburra, looked worse and the table threw at Blair. In round 3 Drew, a lone Sphinx, bluffed a visit to the Turkey and got Farm to eggsecute the real Turkey, Finley. Casey won with 16 points, mostly from one 14-point banked throw in round 2.

title: Rules Lawyers and Wild Cards
headline: Farm kept eggsecuting its own, and the cats cashed in twice.
summary: In round 1 the table caught Finley, a Sphinx who fumbled his claim. In rounds 2 and 3 Farm eggsecuted a Farm player each time, and Meowfia banked big doubled throws. Alex won with 49 after a 26-point round 2 from one throw. Much of the day talk was spent arguing over how Eagle and Owl text works, not over who was lying.

title: The Turkey Takes All
headline: Ellis won round one by luck and coasted to a landslide.
summary: Round 1 was a muddle of misread Turkey and Floofer rules. Farm eggsecuted its own hugged Tit, and Meowfia Ellis and Drew won. In rounds 2 and 3 the Kookaburra, Sphinx and Tit clues gave clear leads, and Farm caught Alex and then Blair. Ellis led from round 1 and was Farm in both later rounds, so they banked big again and finished far ahead.

title: Floofer Walks Into Daylight
headline: A Floofer confessed in round one, a Wink erased the Tit, and Finley won.
summary: Round 1 ended fast: Alex, the Floofer, admitted his role after the Owl's visitor list pinned him. Round 2 went to Meowfia. Ellis Winked the real Tit, and the table threw at Finley, whose confused report had no explanation. Round 3 saw Casey Wink the Owl, but Drew's refusal to name a role drew the vote and the Farm won. Finley won the game on 16 points. The scoring and most claims were hard to read, and the talk was repetitive.

title: The Drew Show
headline: Drew banked double-value Kings off Farm players and ran away with it.
summary: Round 1 was a long argument over how the Eagle works, and the table eggsecuted a true Eagle. Drew, a Meowfia, threw 23 points of cards at Casey and banked 46. Round 2 was a clean Farm win against a Floofer. In round 3 Drew and Blair, both Meowfia, let the table pile onto Casey and banked big. Drew won 112 to 64, and the round-1 jackpot decided the game.

title: Eggs for the Wrong Basket
headline: Two Farm rounds went wrong on confusion, then Casey's Hawk egg cracked round three.
summary: Round 1 and 2 ended with the table throwing at a confused Farm player whose odd egg count could not be explained. Meowfia won round 2 with a lone Sphinx who barely did anything. In round 3 a Hawk egg gave Casey certain proof, Blair was eggsecuted, and Farm banked big cards. Casey won with 20 points, mostly from one round of banking high cards.

title: Blair Always Loses
headline: Blair was a cat all three rounds, and the table voted them out each time.
summary: Blair was Meowfia in every round, and the Farm majority eggsecuted them every time. Round 1 had a Wink kill and a muddled Eagle argument. Rounds 2 and 3 were quick pile-ons built on rule misreadings and unverifiable claims. Ellis won by banking big stakes on the winning side each round, while Blair finished with 9.

title: The Tied Throw
headline: A Mouser's late Wink and a tie-break flipped round three and the whole game.
summary: Farm won the first two rounds by piling onto the obvious liar. Round one was Casey, who was shaky and had a lone Meowfia's shifting story. Round two was Drew, whose false Eagle claim was caught. Alex took an early lead from a big round-one bank and never really fell back. In round three, two Meowfia, Alex and Blair, didn't know each other. Alex winked the Hawk who had exposed Blair, then threw five cards at Casey. That made a 6-6 tie, the tie-break eggsecuted Farm's Casey, and Alex won with 48.

title: Turkey Rules Confusion
headline: Players fumbled the Turkey and Eagle rules while Finley coasted to first.
summary: Round 1 ended on Blair after the Mouser claim exposed a cat role. Round 2 ended on Alex, whose Turkey claim failed against two flat nests. In round 3 the table eggsecuted Finley, a true Falcon, for a story that was correct, and Meowfia won. Finley led from round 1 and kept first place. Much of the table was unsure what the animals do.

title: The Blair Runaway
headline: Blair banked 24 points in round 1 and was never caught.
summary: In round 1, Meowfia Blair winked the loudest accuser, then Blair and Drew threw at Ellis. Ellis was eggsecuted, Meowfia won, and Blair jumped to 26 points. In rounds 2 and 3 Farm correctly eggsecuted the lone Mouser, Drew, but the pots were small. Blair added a Farm win with two Kings in round 3, even though a Wink killed Blair. Blair finished with 64 and nobody else was close.

title: The Blair Runaway
headline: Blair banked 38 points in round one and nobody ever caught up.
summary: Round 1 was a muddle of hug and visit claims. The table piled onto Farm Hawk Casey, and Meowfia won. Blair's two high cards banked at 2x for 38 points, and that lead decided the game. Farm won rounds 2 and 3 by eggsecuting the cat with the weakest story, but nobody could close the gap. Blair finished 50 points ahead.

title: Casey Wins Quietly
headline: Casey lost round one, then won the whole game by being Meowfia once.
summary: Alex, a Meowfia Mouser, got Casey eggsecuted in round 1 with a false Falcon claim and took a big lead. In round 2 Alex was caught after Blair's Turkey claim caused a rules argument. In round 3 Casey, a hidden Floofer, let the table convict Farm Drew on a false Owl and Tit trail. Casey won with only 3 points from a low throw, and ended first at 13.

title: Farm Sweeps, Blair Banks
headline: Farm eggsecuted the Meowfia three times running, and one thrown King decided everything.
summary: Farm won all three rounds. Each time the table piled onto one suspect: a Sphinx who told the truth and got hit anyway, a Sphinx who stayed silent, and a Turkey bluff that nest counts exposed. Meowfia never came close to a win. Blair took the game by throwing a 13 in round 3, while most players threw only their low cards.

title: The Kingmaker Round
headline: Casey banked 48 points in round one and nobody ever caught up.
summary: Round 1 decided the game. Two Meowfia threw big cards at a Farm player the table was already piling on, and banked 48 and 40 points. Rounds 2 and 3 were won by Farm, but each round paid only about 3 to 21 points, so the lead was never in danger. Blair, with shifting claims, was eggsecuted twice as Meowfia.

title: Casey's Early Lead
headline: A lone Meowfia lie in round one snowballed into an untouchable lead.
summary: In round 1 Finley correctly exposed Casey as the Sphinx, but the table split over muddled visit claims and eggsecuted Finley. Casey banked 15 points as the lone winning Meowfia and led the rest of the game. Rounds 2 and 3 saw the Farm catch Meowfia (Drew, then Blair) after contradictions and a Wink, but no one could catch Casey. Casey won with 40.

title: The Wink Parade
headline: Meowfia winked away witnesses, then one 56-point throw decided everything.
summary: Farm won rounds 1 and 2 by voting out a cat each time, even though Mouser Winks killed the Owl both times. Round 3 went to Meowfia. Alex and Drew leaned on a muddled Turkey argument until Farm Finley was eggsecuted. Drew threw three high cards at Finley and banked 56 points at 2x, jumping from 17 to 77 and winning. Alex, who led for two rounds, finished second.

title: Casey Takes the Fall
headline: Farm eggsecuted its own Kookaburra twice, even after she named the Sphinx.
summary: Round 1 was a fog of misread Owl and Kookaburra rules, and Farm threw out Casey, who was Farm. Round 2 was the clean win: Blair's fake Hawk claim collapsed against her flat nest and the table hit the Floofer. In round 3 Casey truthfully outed Drew as the Sphinx, but the table decided a Kookaburra can't learn "Sphinx". They eggsecuted her and handed Meowfia the round. The game ended in a three-way tie at 10 between Alex, Casey and Drew.

title: Wrong Hawk, Lost Eagle
headline: A truthful Hawk got eggsecuted, and a Wink silenced the table's only reliable Eagle.
summary: Round 1 saw Blair, a Meowfia Sphinx, survive. Drew's honest Hawk egg was the only hard proof against him, and the table threw at Drew instead. Round 2 turned on a Mouser Wink that killed the Eagle, and on a confused Kookaburra's +2 that framed an honest Owl. Round 3 went to Farm when Alex's clumsy Owl claim failed the egg math. Blair won on 24, mostly from round 1's lucky Meowfia win and round 3's Farm win.

title: Winks and Wrong Eagles
headline: A hugged Eagle got eggsecuted, then Casey banked two big Farm wins.
summary: Round 1 went wrong for Farm. Casey's hugged Eagle gave a true zero, the table read it as a lie, and Farm threw out its own player while lone Meowfia Ellis won. In rounds 2 and 3 Farm caught the Meowfia each time, because claims contradicted night reports. Casey banked large throws in both rounds and won 29 to 16.

title: Finley's Quiet Harvest
headline: Finley banked two Farm kills as Meowfia and lapped the table.
summary: Round 1 was a tangle of egg math. The table threw at a true Hawk, and the Meowfia pair Drew and Finley banked 2x on it. Round 2 repeated the pattern: a true Eagle was eggsecuted because he misexplained his own ability. Round 3 went to Farm, when a real Hawk egg exposed Blair. By then Finley led 87 to 57, and Finley, Drew and Blair were the only players in contention.

title: The Thirteen-Egg Snipe
headline: A winked Hawk died silent, then threw a 13 and won everything.
summary: Round 1 was an easy Farm win after Drew's fake Pigeon claim failed against nest counts. In round 2 a lone Floofer hugged the Hawk and Tit, which made Blair look clean, and a 4–4 tie sent a Farm player to the vote. In round 3 Blair winked Finley, the only player who had identified a cat, but Finley still threw a 13 from beyond the grave and banked it. Finley finished with 30 points against 16 for second place, so the last round decided the game.

title: Snowball of the Cats
headline: Two cats framed one honest Tit and won the whole game.
summary: Farm hanged a Meowfia in rounds 1 and 3, because Alex dodged questions and then told a Hawk lie that the Owl list contradicted. In round 2 Casey and Finley were cats together. They framed Farm Tit Drew with muddled visit stories and banked 16 points each. That one round decided the game: Finley won with 49 and Casey took second with 47. The Farm players who won twice finished far behind.

title: The Lone Cat Wins
headline: Ellis won round one dead, round two as a cat, and the game.
summary: In round 1 the Mouser Drew winked the Owl Ellis, which exposed him, and Farm threw him out. In round 2 Ellis was the lone Meowfia. He hid behind a misread Falcon rule while Farm threw out the Farm Kookaburra Blair. In round 3 Drew's false Hawk claim was broken by Ellis's clean report, and Farm won again. Ellis finished first with 28 against Blair's 15, helped by a banked 8 in round 1 and a solo cat win worth 5 in round 2.

title: Winks and Wild Cards
headline: Farm cracked round one fast, then voted out its own Eagle and Falcon.
summary: Round 1 was a clean Farm win. Blair's Mouser was exposed by Kookaburra, Hawk and Eagle info, and Casey banked 23 points. In rounds 2 and 3 Farm tangled itself in Eagle and Falcon visit counts and eggsecuted a Farm player each time. Drew won with 31 points, helped by the round-1 bank and a round-2 Meowfia win. Casey's 27 came almost entirely from round 1.

title: The Wild Banker
headline: Ellis won by losing Farm rounds and banking one lucky Meowfia throw.
summary: Round 1 saw a lone Meowfia Sphinx hide in plain sight while the table eggsecuted Farm Blair for an unverifiable claim. In round 2 Meowfia Mouser Ellis cleanly framed Finley, who had a confused report, and banked 14 points by throwing two high cards. That lead decided the game. In round 3 Farm caught Meowfia Casey through a Kookaburra clue, but the cheap throws only moved Ellis from 18 to 25.

title: Alex Runs Away
headline: Three easy Meowfia lynchings later, Alex's early high throws won the game.
summary: Farm won all three rounds by eggsecuting a Meowfia player each time. Round 1 and 2 were solved fast by a Hawk egg and a Kookaburra read, and a Mouser Wink did nothing to save its owner. Round 3 was muddier, with a Floofer hug, a confused Kookaburra and a dodging Sphinx, but the table still threw at the right target. Alex banked 12 and 25 points on big throws early and was never caught, so the final standings were settled by round 2.

title: Eggs Nobody Could Source
headline: Farm eggsecuted its own twice while Meowfia quietly banked the win.
summary: Round 1 ended with Farm eggsecuting Casey, a true Farm Hawk, after a confused Kookaburra report made her look like a liar. Round 2 went to Farm. Finley's Mouser winked the Owl, but Finley's shifting story got Finley voted out. In round 3 the table split between Casey's unsourced +3 and Finley's Owl claim, and Farm eggsecuted Finley, who was Farm. Drew, Meowfia in rounds 1 and 3, won the game 16 to 15 over Blair.

title: Wink, Wilds, Runaway Leader
headline: Alex coasted to a 29-point win while the table argued about eggs.
summary: Round 1 was a mess of Eagle and Owl math, and Farm eggsecuted its own Owl, so the lone Meowfia Drew won. Round 2 Farm caught Casey over a double Hawk claim, and Alex and Finley banked 9 each by throwing cards for a win. In round 3 Alex, a Sphinx, led a push on Blair for an unexplained +1. Blair was Farm, so Meowfia won and Alex banked 17 to finish far ahead.

title: Three Wrong Eggsecutions
headline: The table eggsecuted a Farm player three rounds running; Meowfia cashed in.
summary: Every vote landed on a Farm player, so Meowfia won all three rounds. Round 1 turned on an argument over how the Eagle works. Round 2 turned on an unexplained +1 egg. In round 3 Blair, a Meowfia Sphinx, threw two low cards at Casey and banked 8 points, jumping from 5 to 13 and winning the game. Several true pieces of evidence were dismissed or misread.

title: Four Visitors, One Wink
headline: A Wink silenced the only true Eagle, and Meowfia banked the winning round.
summary: Round 1 turned on a muddled Eagle rule, and the table eggsecuted a Farm Eagle. Round 2 was easy: Alex's false Pigeon claim was caught at once. In round 3 the Mouser winked the Eagle, whose report was true. Ellis's shifting Turkey story then made him the scapegoat, and Blair won the game with 27 points.

title: The Wink Spoils Finley
headline: A lone cat winked the Eagle and the table ate an innocent Kookaburra.
summary: Round 1 was a muddle of rule misreads, but Farm still eggsecuted the Floofer. In round 2 Sphinx Alex was caught after his visit story shifted under an Eagle check. In round 3 the lone Meowfia, Mouser Casey, winked the Eagle. The table then piled onto a confused Kookaburra, and Farm lost. Finley won the game on round 2 points.

title: The Wink Gives It Away
headline: A Mouser's wink exposed him, and a clumsy House Cat bluff doomed Casey.
summary: Round 1 was a blank night, and Farm eggsecuted its own Owl, Blair, on no evidence. In round 2, Alex's Kookaburra named Ellis as the Mouser. Ellis winked Alex, and that pointed straight back at him. In round 3, Casey, a Sphinx, claimed House Cat, which is a Meowfia animal, and the table piled on. Alex won with 20 points, mostly from one 11-point throw banked while dead.

title: The Wink Lands Late
headline: A lone Meowfia winks the trusted voice and wins the whole game.
summary: Round 1 saw the table pile onto Blair, an honest Eagle, over a muddled visit count. The lone Meowfia, Ellis, won by staying quiet. Round 2 caught Finley, a Sphinx bluffing Turkey, because Drew's fake Owl story clashed with it, and Blair banked 14 points. In round 3 Alex, a lone Meowfia Mouser, winked the leader Blair mid-day. The table then voted out Drew, a confused Kookaburra, and Alex banked 15 to win 20 to 17.

title: Two Farm Casualties
headline: Farm nailed Blair, then eggsecuted innocent Casey twice while Drew banked 42.
summary: Round 1 was a clean Farm win: Kookaburra, Hawk and Eagle claims all pointed at Blair the Sphinx. In rounds 2 and 3 the Farm table fixated on Casey, who was Farm both times, and Meowfia won both rounds. Drew, a Meowfia Floofer in round 3 with a large hand, banked 21 and won the game at 42.

title: The Hawk's Egg
headline: Finley rode one lucky Hawk egg and a 25-point throw to a runaway win.
summary: Farm won all three rounds, each time by eggsecuting a Meowfia the table had converged on. Round 1 hinged on a duplicate Hawk claim. Round 2 hinged on a Hawk's gained egg, which proved Casey was Meowfia. Round 3 hinged on a Wink that pointed straight back at the Mouser. Finley banked a 25-point King-heavy throw in round 2 and finished far ahead, while the Meowfia never came close to a win.

title: Silent Floofer Wins Twice
headline: Farm eggsecuted a Farm player every round, and the Meowfia mostly stayed quiet.
summary: Round 1 ended with Farm piling onto a confused Kookaburra, and the silent Floofer Finley won. In round 2, Meowfia Casey and Alex stood out of the way and let Farm kill Ellis, the true Eagle, and Casey took 11 points with a banked King and a high card. Round 3 hit another Farm player, Blair, after a long tangle of rule misreadings. Casey won on the round 2 haul and never lost the lead. Finley, the only Meowfia who won twice, did it with a single card thrown.

title: Wild Throws, Easy Votes
headline: Farm lynched its own Kookaburra, then twice caught Meowfia by contradiction.
summary: Round 1 ended with Farm eggsecuting a confused Kookaburra while the lone Meowfia Sphinx bluffed an Owl and won. In rounds 2 and 3 the Meowfia were caught quickly, by a shifting Hawk story and by a Turkey-egg contradiction. Ellis won the game by banking mid-value cards on winning throws. The Meowfia had little power to disrupt anything.

title: The Ellis Runaway
headline: Ellis banked 52 points by throwing high cards at winning votes, three rounds running.
summary: Farm won rounds 1 and 3 by voting out a Meowfia who had just winked someone. Round 2 went to Meowfia when the table eggsecuted a confused Kookaburra. Ellis, the Tit in round 1 and a Sphinx and then a Turkey after that, won all three rounds and threw big cards each time. He finished with 52 points, more than double second place. The other five players were playing for second from round 2 on.

title: Wink Wins Round Three
headline: Meowfia lost two rounds, then a Wink and a lie stole the game.
summary: Round 1 was a lone Sphinx with a bad Owl bluff, and the table piled on Alex fast. In round 2 the two Meowfia did not know each other. Ellis's Wink killed an accuser but could not save him, and Ellis was eggsecuted. In round 3 Blair's Wink on the Eagle and Casey's heavy throws got a Farm player eggsecuted. Both Meowfia finished first and second, because that one round banked huge cards.

title: Wink Wins Rounds
headline: Two silent Winks sank Farm before Blair's banked lead survived round three.
summary: In round 1 the Mouser Ellis winked the Owl, Blair, who was the only checkable witness. Ellis then helped push the vote onto Farm's Finley. In round 2 Blair, now the Mouser, winked Drew, the real Hawk who had exposed Ellis, and threw at Alex, who took the vote. Meowfia won both rounds, and Blair banked 14 points. In round 3 Blair was Farm and Ellis was the lone Mouser. Ellis winked Blair but was still eggsecuted, and Blair won the game with 26.

title: Drew Takes the Fall
headline: Drew was eggsecuted three rounds running, and Meowfia cashed in twice.
summary: Drew, a Farm player every round, was eggsecuted in all three rounds because of shaky claims and a counting slip. Alex used a Wink in round 1 to kill the loudest Farm accuser and won with Meowfia. Ellis won round 2 almost unseen. Casey won round 3 with a false Kookaburra claim that nobody could break. Alex finished first on 13 points.

title: Winks and Wrong Eggs
headline: A Mouser outed himself, a true Hawk got eggsecuted, and Casey won quietly.
summary: Round 1 was a quick Farm win. Casey's Owl report exposed Ellis the Mouser, and Ellis's Wink on Blair did not save him. In round 2 a lone Meowfia, Drew, hid while the table eggsecuted Finley, a true Hawk who had misread his own egg. In round 3 two Meowfia lied smoothly, Farm threw at Ellis, and Casey finished first on 27 points.

title: Typo Gives It Away
headline: Farm eggsecuted itself twice, then a Floofer's slip handed Drew the win.
summary: Rounds 1 and 2 were muddy. Players argued over how the Owl egg works, and Farm eggsecuted its own Blair, then its own Drew. Meowfia won both rounds with little effort. In round 3 Ellis, a Meowfia Floofer, said "Farm", then admitted Floofer, and the table piled on. Drew banked 14 points in that throw and finished first with 20.

title: The Wink Flips It
headline: Farm solved two rounds easily, then a Meowfia pair framed the Hawk and won.
summary: Rounds 1 and 2 were quick Farm wins. A Hawk egg named the Meowfia and everyone piled on. Blair banked big and led after round 2. In round 3 Casey winked the Owl Blair, then both Meowfia threw at Alex. The Farm split its votes and Alex was eggsecuted. Ellis and Casey took first and second, and the Farm team that was right all day lost.

title: Three Farm Funerals
headline: Three rounds, three innocent Farm players eggsecuted, and nobody tested the pile-on.
summary: Every round ended with a Farm player eggsecuted. The table piled onto one outlier within a few beats and never tested the story. Round 1 hit a confused Kookaburra. Round 2 hit an honest Kookaburra whose report was blanked by a hug. Round 3 hit the true Turkey, who was contradicted by a Meowfia Sphinx. Ellis won at 11 by being Meowfia in round 2 and staying quiet in round 3.

title: Eagle Rules Meltdown
headline: Two Farm players argued over Eagle rules and eggsecuted the real Owl.
summary: Round 1 and 2 ended with the table correctly eggsecuting a Meowfia, helped by nest-count contradictions and a clumsy fake Pigeon and fake Kookaburra. Round 3 broke down: Alex (Eagle) and Blair (Owl) both told the truth about their night, but misread how the Eagle scores, and the table threw at Blair. The lone Meowfia, Drew, hugged Alex, stayed quiet and won without being suspected. Alex finished first at 12 points, ahead of Finley on 10.

title: The Eagle Rule Fiasco
headline: Farm eggsecuted Farm three times while the Meowfia mostly sat back and collected.
summary: Every round ended with a Farm player eggsecuted. In round 1 the table piled onto Casey, a true Falcon, because nobody could agree how the Eagle pays. In round 2 the same argument ate the day, and Ellis was voted out even though nobody had a clear case against him. In round 3 a Floofer hug and a Pigeon's egg gave Drew an unexplainable +3. The table threw at Drew, and the two Meowfia, Blair and Finley, took 18 points between them. Finley won with 17.

title: The Eagle Nobody Believed
headline: Farm Eagle Casey was lynched twice for telling the truth about eggs.
summary: Casey was eggsecuted in all three rounds. Twice they were honest Farm Eagle, and the table misread the Eagle rule and killed them. Meowfia won round 1 and round 2 almost by accident. In round 3 Casey was Meowfia and was caught fast after a clumsy Falcon bluff. Finley won the game by banking a 9-point score on the one correct vote.

title: Winks and Wrong Turkeys
headline: A lone Mouser's Wink and a bluffed Turkey won the game for Finley.
summary: Round 1 ended with the table throwing at Alex, a Farm Kookaburra whose confused +2 looked like a lie. Round 2 was solved cleanly: Drew's Hawk egg exposed Blair, and a Wink could not save them. Round 3 turned on a Turkey rule dispute. Finley, the Meowfia Mouser, winked Drew, bluffed Turkey and escaped. Farm then eggsecuted Ellis and Finley banked a 13 to win.

title: Hugs and Silent Winks
headline: Ellis, a Farm leader, skated through three rounds and won by banking safely.
summary: Round 1 was thin: a Floofer hugged every visitor, a false Owl claim passed, and Alex still got eggsecuted. In round 2 Blair's Pigeon bluff broke against Casey's Eagle count and Meowfia lost. In round 3 Casey's Hawk egg and Drew's Owl read exposed Ellis, and his Wink killed the accuser but could not stop the vote. Ellis won on 18 mostly from one early 8-point bank and a final-round return of a Wild, not from deduction in the final standings.

title: Winks and Wrong Owls
headline: Farm caught the cat in round one, then ate its own Owl twice.
summary: Round 1 went to Farm: Casey's Hawk hit on Blair was real, and Alex's Wink on Ellis could not save the cats. Rounds 2 and 3 went the other way. The table piled onto Casey, a Farm Owl, because the egg-count logic was muddled, and Meowfia won both. Casey and Ellis tied at 18, but the tiebreak is not in the rules. Casey was the only player to correctly guess a cat in round 1, then was wrongly eggsecuted twice.

title: Wrong Cat, Right Mob
headline: The table crushed a Farm player twice while the lone Meowfia walked off richer.
summary: Round 1 caught Meowfia Ellis after a muddled day and a Wink on Casey. In rounds 2 and 3 the table piled onto Drew, who was Farm both times, on weak evidence. Casey, a hidden Floofer, banked 6 points in round 3 and nearly caught Drew. Drew won the game at 14 by being eggsecuted while holding his high cards.

title: Wrong Eagle, Wrong Blair
headline: Two Farm players got eggsecuted on bad egg math while one lone cat won.
summary: Round 1 had one Meowfia, Casey, who hid with a Kookaburra claim while the table piled onto Farm Eagle Alex over a visitor-count quibble. Round 2 went the other way: Casey's Hawk claim contradicted Blair's clean Kookaburra report, and the table caught her. In round 3 Drew, a Sphinx, hid behind a confused Kookaburra's unexplained +3 while Ellis's correct Hawk read was ignored. Blair was eggsecuted and Drew banked the win. Alex and Blair tied at 12 with Drew third on 10.

title: Turkey Rule Confusion
headline: Drew's Wink and a misread Turkey carried Meowfia to an easy win.
summary: Round 1 was lost by Farm because nobody understood the Turkey. They threw at the real Turkey, even though Finley's Owl had exposed two cats visiting her. In round 2 Drew, the Mouser, winked the Turkey Ellis. He then helped push the vote onto Finley, who was telling the truth about Alex, and banked 16 points. In round 3 Blair, the lone Meowfia, copied the Tit role while the real Tit stood alone. Drew finished with 23 against Alex's 12.

title: Ellis Takes the Fall
headline: Finley banks a huge round-one throw and coasts to a wire-to-wire win.
summary: Ellis was Meowfia in rounds 1 and 2 and was eggsecuted both times after lying about his visits. Finley threw a high card stack in round 1 for 10 points, then added 9 in round 2, and nobody could catch up. In round 3 a confused Kookaburra's unexplained egg got Drew, a Farm player, eggsecuted, so Meowfia won. Finley still led by 8 points.

title: The Quiet Mouser
headline: A lone Mouser stayed silent, winked once, and framed the Owl for a 35-point finish.
summary: Farm won rounds 1 and 2 by piling onto Drew, who was Meowfia both times. Ellis banked a 10-point King-level throw in round 1 and Blair banked 14 in round 2. In round 3 Drew was the lone Meowfia, stayed silent, then claimed Pigeon to explain Blair's confused egg. The Farm split on Alex and Ellis, threw Alex out, and Drew banked 34 points to win the game.

title: Floofer Gets Caught
headline: A lone Meowfia won round one by default, then cats fell to egg math.
summary: Round 1 had one Meowfia, a silent Mouser, while the table piled onto a confused Farm Kookaburra and handed Alex the win. In round 2 Alex dodged naming a role, winked Drew mid-day, and was eggsecuted anyway. In round 3 Finley's Eagle count and Blair's Owl list exposed the Floofer Casey. Ellis, who threw a 5 on a winning vote, ended first at 12 with only one round of Meowfia play.

title: Wink and Wrong Rules
headline: Farm eggsecuted Farm three times while a lone Mouser banked 22 points.
summary: Farm voted out a Farm player in all three rounds, and the Meowfia won every time. In round 1 Casey's true Eagle report was muddled and the table piled on. In round 2 Blair, a Mouser, winked the Falcon and claimed Pigeon, then steered the vote onto Ellis for a 22-point win. In round 3 Blair was Farm, and a hug left their Falcon report empty, so they were voted out as a liar. Players misread the Eagle, Turkey and Falcon rules over and over.

title: The Wasted Wink
headline: Finley banked a 19-point round, then the table voted out the wrong Farmer.
summary: Round 1 was a fog of Farm claims. The table piled onto Blair over a misread Owl rule, and the lone Meowfia, Ellis, won without lifting a finger. Round 2 was clean. Alex's Owl and Finley's Hawk both pointed at the Mouser, Drew, and Farm won. Finley banked a huge pile. In round 3 a confused Kookaburra report made Blair look like a liar. The Meowfia winked the leader and let Farm eggsecute Blair. Finley still won by 12 points.

title: Blair Banks Big
headline: Blair won round one by throwing at the Turkey, then coasted to 43.
summary: Blair, a lone Sphinx in round 1, learned who the Turkey was. Blair threw three cards at that Farm player, and the table's own mistaken vote on Finley still gave Blair 15 points. Blair then led all game. A Mouser Wink killed Blair in round 2, but Blair still banked a big throw in round 3 and finished far ahead of everyone. The table spent most of its time arguing about what the animals do, and not much on who was lying.

title: Three Cats, One Wink
headline: Three winks, three dead truth-tellers, and a Sphinx wins by two points with handshakes.
summary: Farm won round 1 when the real Tit exposed Ellis's fake Tit claim. Round 2 was dealt three Meowfia, which the rules forbid. Alex then threw at his own partner and lost the cats the round on a coin-flip tie. In round 3 the engine again dealt three cats. Blair winked Ellis, the honest Owl, which voided his doubled 7-card vote. The cats eggsecuted him, and Casey's double down plus three handshakes lifted her from 30 to 71, edging Blair by 2.

title: The Hawk Speaks Twice
headline: Two cats framed the real Tit, then a dead Hawk banked the win.
summary: In round 1, Alex and Blair were the cats. They did not know each other, but they backed each other's fake claims and got the real Tit, Drew, eggsecuted. Both banked big, doubled scores. Alex was the Mouser again in rounds 2 and 3. He was caught both times, the second time even after he winked Blair, the Hawk who exposed him. Blair played a clever Sphinx in round 2 and doubled down as Hawk in round 3, so Blair won with 94. Every Farm player doubled down in the final round, which tripled the score totals.

title: The Mouser's Three Winks
headline: Blair loses two of three rounds and still wins by 28, thanks to one doubled bet.
summary: Alex was the Mouser in all three rounds and winked Casey twice. In round 1 the Wink backfired: it proved Casey was the real Hawk, and Blair was eggsecuted. In round 2 the same Wink erased Casey's four doubled votes, and the cats eggsecuted Ellis even though Farm had read the round correctly. Blair banked 102 doubled points that round, so round 3 was really a vote on the leader. The whole table piled onto Blair, the honest Hawk, and the game ended with Blair first anyway.

title: The Third Cat
headline: A truthful Owl got eggsecuted because the game secretly dealt three cats.
summary: In round 1, Alex's fake Tit claim ran into the real Tit, Blair. Alex then outed himself as Maine Coon with a failed challenge, and Farm won easily. In rounds 2 and 3 the setup broke its own rule and dealt three Meowfia. In round 2, Finley's accurate Owl report showed three cats visiting Drew. The cats called it impossible under the rules, and the table eggsecuted Finley, who was telling the truth. In round 3, Blair's anonymous Wink killed Ellis and wiped out Ellis's six doubled-down votes. That flipped the eggsecution onto Drew, and Blair won the game 84 to 69.

title: The Eagle's Big Nest
headline: The outed Mouser lost round one, then won the game with one 65-point throw.
summary: Drew was Meowfia in both rounds, and both times the table caught him easily by cross-checking info roles. In round 1 Alex was outed as the Mouser. He winked Finley, which only confirmed it, but the Farm still voted out his partner Drew. In round 2 Alex was a Farm Eagle. Four players visited his target, so he grew to 11 cards and threw 10 of them at the obvious Sphinx. That one throw took him from last place to a 20-point win.

title: The Pigeon Who Wasn't
headline: An honest Lazy Pigeon tells the truth, and the table eggsecutes him for it.
summary: Gray was a Lazy Pigeon who believed he was a Pigeon. He visited Alex, the Turkey, who stays home. So Alex got no egg and Gray got one from the Turkey. Both told the truth, but their stories seemed to clash. Ellis built a tidy case that Gray was a lying cat, and the table voted 6 to 1 against him. Blair, the only Meowfia, claimed Hawk, was never questioned, and took 18 points and the game.

title: The Phantom Pigeon Egg
headline: An honest Pigeon's missing egg gets her eggsecuted while the lone cat banks 35.
summary: Drew was the only Meowfia, a Sphinx. Drew confused Alex the Kookaburra and then told one small lie, a Hawk claim. Blair truthfully said she laid an egg in Casey. Blair was secretly a Lazy Pigeon, so that egg actually went to Drew. Her claim clashed with Casey's correct egg math. Nobody considered the Lazy Pigeon, so the table read the mismatch as a lie. Sunflower checks and handshakes built a solid Farm bloc that threw 6 to 1 at Blair. Drew threw with that bloc and won 37 to 5.

title: Two Tits, Two Owls
headline: Both cats claimed roles that were already taken, and both got caught fast.
summary: Casey's Hawk egg pinned Drew in the first beat of Round 1. Drew winked Casey anyway, then gave himself away by calling himself "Mouser-free". In Round 2 Finley the Sphinx claimed Owl, but the real Owl, Drew, outed him straight away. Finley then found a real lie, Casey's Hawk claim, but only after the day had ended. Alex was Farm in both rounds and held a 13 to throw, so he won 46 to 38. Finley was Meowfia twice and finished with 7.

title: The Honest Kookaburra
headline: A truthful Kookaburra is voted out by a 1-in-11 coincidence, and Drew banks 41 points.
summary: In round 1, a fluke decided the vote. Casey was confused, and the wrong role in his report happened to be Blair's fake Eagle claim. The table did the odds and voted out the honest player. In round 2, Drew posed as a Kookaburra and gave a fake clean read on Casey, who was secretly the Floofer. That pushed the vote onto Finley, a real Falcon, and Drew banked 41 points with his kept high cards. Farm finally won round 3 when Ellis claimed Kookaburra late and misstated Finley's argument, but Drew's lead was already safe.

title: The Missing Eight
headline: A forgotten returned card framed an honest Owl and handed the cats the game.
summary: In Round 1, Drew was the only Meowfia, as the Sphinx. He gave himself away by changing his guess mid-sentence during a bluff, and five Farm players piled their cards on him. In Round 2, Ellis worked out Drew's starting nest size but forgot the S8 that came back to Drew after Round 1. That wrong math made the honest Owl Drew look like a liar. Drew got muddled too and attacked the honest Tit Ellis. The Farm split, and Ellis was eggsecuted 9 votes to 8. Finley, the Sphinx, won the game.

title: Three Blank Visits
headline: Three players visited the Floofer, all came back blank, and the Floofer was caught.
summary: Drew, the Floofer, was visited by Alex, Casey and Ellis by chance, and it hugged all three of them. Each came back with an empty report. Drew then claimed Hawk, but Casey was the real Hawk, and the three blanks matched up. That sank Drew within a few exchanges. Blair, the Sphinx, gave a well-built fake Owl claim and was never caught, but the table eggsecuted Drew 16 votes to 6 and Farm won.

title: Egg Math Catches Cats
headline: Two lone cats, two egg-count lies, and a silent Alex wins anyway.
summary: There was only one Meowfia in each round, and the egg counts caught both. In round 1, Sphinx Drew claimed Pigeon. Blair's math showed Finley's nest had no room for Drew's egg, and the table convicted him. In round 2, Mouser Casey made a clever Hawk bluff using a real Turkey egg, but Drew's Owl report showed a Mouser had visited Finley, and Casey went down 5 votes to 1. Alex never said a word all game, threw his 11s with the majority, and won.

title: The Empty Barn
headline: Six farmers egged an innocent Hawk, then one Eagle visit banked 65 points.
summary: Round 1 had no Meowfia at all. Alex misread a Turkey egg as a Tit hit, and the table piled onto Finley, the honest Hawk. Every thrown card was lost. In round 2, five players happened to visit the Meowfia Sphinx Casey. Finley's Eagle got four eggs and a full visitor list, so Casey was an easy catch, and Finley won by 50 points.

title: Sphinx Caught Twice
headline: Drew got caught as the Sphinx twice, and the Farm swept a lopsided game.
summary: Drew was the Meowfia Sphinx in both rounds, and his false claims were broken within a few messages both times. In round 1, Ellis's Turkey disproved his Tit story. In round 2, Casey, the real Owl, and Alex's Kookaburra both caught him at once. Finley, his unknown teammate, never came under suspicion, but he also never helped, and he left his Wink unused. Casey won 61 to Drew's 5. Two phantom cards from a confused report helped her.

title: The Lucky Pigeon Lie
headline: A lucky Pigeon lie framed the one honest Tit and won Blair the game.
summary: In Round 1, Blair was the only Meowfia. Blair invented a Pigeon visit to Ellis, and by chance it matched the egg Ellis really got from Alex the Turkey. The table eggsecuted Ellis, who had told the truth, and Blair banked 26 points alone. Farm caught the Meowfia in Rounds 2 and 3, Drew and then Alex, both times because that player was slow to claim a role. Blair's Round 1 haul held up, and Blair won 48 to Ellis's 44.

title: Blair, Cat Three Times
headline: Blair was the cat all three rounds and finally won when the table eggsecuted honest Ellis.
summary: In round 1 the egg counts were clear enough for Drew to work out that Ellis was the Floofer, and Farm won. Round 2 was decided by what happened in round 1: Blair's nest was one card too big, which showed that a consolation card had come back. Blair admitted to being the cat and was eggsecuted, and two other cats helped throw at Blair. In round 3 the deck ran out, so egg reports stopped changing nest sizes. The table had to guess between two equal stories and eggsecuted Ellis, an honest Pigeon. Blair, a cat for the third time, banked 28. Casey won on points, and Ellis finished with 1.

title: The Silent Floofer Hug
headline: A silent Floofer hug corrupted every info report, yet the table caught it anyway
summary: In round 1, Blair (Mouser) claimed Hawk right after the real Hawk, Alex. The table eggsecuted Alex, and Blair took a 31-point lead. Alex was then the Floofer in rounds 2 and 3. Both times an Owl or Hawk caught his fake Hawk claim, and Farm won. Blair held the round 1 lead to finish on 69. Alex finished last on 8 after losing all three rounds. Hugs were never reported to the players hit by them, and many players misread nest sizes. Together these made a lot of wrong claims, most of them by honest Farm players.

title: Unseen Hugs
headline: Unseen hugs make two honest investigators look like liars, and the cats cash in.
summary: Farm won round 1 cleanly when Drew's Eagle caught Blair's House Cat visit, and Drew banked 51 on one all-in throw. Then the Floofer took over. In rounds 2 and 3 a hugged investigator (Casey's Eagle, then Drew's Falcon) got an unrelated egg, misread it as a role reward, gave a false report and was eggsecuted as Farm. Finley's Sphinx knew the innocent target both times and piled on. Alex won 66 to 64 over Finley, by the one point from a consolation card kept in the nest.

title: Swaps and Confessions
headline: Swaps flipped a team every round, and honest confessions won two of the three
summary: This game ran on alignment swaps. Every round a Top Cat or a Switcheroo turned a player to the other side overnight. In round 1 Alex told the truth about his Top Cat swap, but the table did the egg math wrong and eggsecuted him. That handed dead Casey 10 points and a lead she never lost. In rounds 2 and 3 the swapped player confessed, the table believed them, and Farm won easily. Ellis's lies went unpunished in the talk, but he finished on 5 after throwing at his own teammate in round 3.

title: The Top Cat Flips
headline: The Top Cat flipped someone every round, and the deck ran dry.
summary: Farm won the first two rounds easily. The table caught a cagey Top Cat (Alex) and then a Top Cat who joked "I'm Top Cat... kidding" (Blair). In round 3 the deck was empty, so eggs stopped showing up as cards. A Top Cat flip plus a Switcheroo swap left three Meowfia at the table. The Meowfia piled onto Blair, an honest Mosquito, and won. Ellis won on 66, mostly from one banked throw of 12, 13 and 13 in round 1.

title: Two Maine Coons Bust
headline: Two Maine Coons bust themselves, and Ellis throws his whole 94-point nest.
summary: Blair's Maine Coon got caught in a Hawk-claim clash in round 1. Blair then won the round alone just by repeating the table's honest claims. Round 2 had no Meowfia at all. The table felt that but still had to throw, picked the one player who wouldn't name his animal, and everyone lost their cards. Round 3 dealt four cats. Both Maine Coons made failed challenges and exposed themselves. Finley then showed that Casey's 'no egg on Blair' Hawk result was impossible, and Ellis banked 94 points in one throw.

title: Cats Egg Their Own
headline: Three cats outnumber the farm, then two of them egg their own teammate.
summary: Wolfsbane made three of five players Meowfia, and all three were House Cats. They had the voting majority and still lost. Drew gave a sloppy Pigeon claim, changed it, and the whole table piled on him, including fellow cat Ellis. Blair's Lyrebird turned one free visit into 5 extra cards, and those cards became the biggest throw and the winning score.

title: A Busted Cat Comes Back
headline: Busted cat in round two rides a 13-card nest to a first-place tie.
summary: Round 1 had no Meowfia. Under Banksia, players passed whispers from neighbour to neighbour, worked out that every egg was accounted for, and each threw one cheap card. In rounds 2 and 3 a lone House Cat (Casey, then Ellis) made up a Pigeon claim that the egg counts and an Owl report disproved within one or two beats, and the votes were nearly unanimous. Casey was caught in round 2, but she was Farm Vogelkop in round 3. She threw the big nest she had hoarded and banked 60, which tied her with Drew at 65.

title: The Unnoticed Goose
headline: A hidden Goose flipped every round, and nobody at the table noticed.
summary: In round 1, four honest Farm Geese suspected each other while two Cat Burglers kept quiet. The table eggsecuted Drew, whose net-zero report was true. Round 2 had no Meowfia at all. The table eggsecuted Blair for a Lyrebird story that was actually correct, and Ellis banked 21 points. In round 3, Alex openly claimed a cat role and nobody punished it. The table caught Drew, a real Meowfia, but the Goose was still in the pool and inverted scoring, so the four Meowfia won and the two Farm players who voted correctly lost. Ellis won 36 to 26 mostly through that one round 2 throw, without ever reasoning about the Goose.
